ownerDirection: Battle-scarred general and furious war priest; sheer aggression. Camp weapons/gear forging. Same underlying astral biological material as leader/Glutton but different colour, corruption, face, anatomy and regalia. No leader-exclusive features.
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Create ONE original character concept sheet for BUTCHER, a dark astral cult survivor and the camp's WEAPONS AND GEAR FORGER in Kindred Siege. He is a hybrid of a battle-scarred GENERAL and a furious WAR PRIEST. The principal trait is sheer aggression: a physically intimidating intelligent veteran, disciplined enough to command, with furious conviction barely held inside his body. An original almost completely alien form, not an existing fantasy character.

DESIGN FIRST, AT A GLANCE:
A tall severe upright angular silhouette, long powerful legs, narrow dense waist, a deep projecting wedge-shaped chest and massive elongated forearms like living forging presses. Around seven and a half heads tall, weighty realistic heroic anatomy. Two arms and two legs, all functionally intact for this provisional anatomy study; no chosen amputation or prosthetic backstory. His large body must feel sinewy, hardened and built to exert crushing force, not swollen, round, obese or like a conventional human bodybuilder. Shoulders are broad but clean, with asymmetric armour: one single low rectangular black-glass shoulder slab and the opposite upper shoulder exposed. Head held forward on a visible thick sinewy neck. Plant both feet in a wide commanding stance, torso angled three-quarter front, eyes looking straight at the viewer. His free hand is half-clenched, tendons tense; the other grips a heavy forging tool resting head-down beside his boot. Emphasise verticality, squared brutal geometry and compressive force.

ALIEN FACE, NOT THE LEADER OR GLUTTON:
A tall flat-fronted stern cranium, subtly rectangular rather than pointed or round. Smooth dark living nacre forehead, two narrow deep lateral eye apertures recessed under one heavy unbroken brow, pale dull antique-gold eyes without glow. No human protruding nose or external ears. Strong long angular cheek planes, a compact broad lower jaw of interlocking blunt nacre plates, one tightly compressed mouth slit expressing barely contained anger. NOT a skull face, not a robotic helmet and not a lion or lizard snout. An old oblique healed wound deforms part of the brow and cheek, repaired by small organically integrated ancient-gold staples. Scars convey experience but do not blind him or decide the story of his defeat. He looks capable of an impatient dry remark; intelligence and personality remain visible. No cheerful grin, no villain cackle, no permanently open roaring maw.
One small matching close-up portrait shows him sharply barking a reprimand with the mouth slightly open and the same two-eye anatomy. Expression change is subtle and credible, not a second design.
Absolutely NO forehead eye, transparent brain, dreads, beard braids, leader crown, horns, antlers, halo or floating headpieces. No Glutton-like layered wide smiling cheek shelves.

SHARED ORIGIN, DIFFERENT COLOUR AND CORRUPTION:
His underlying living skin material is deep mother-of-pearl with biological augmentation, shared with his dark astral people, but coloured blackened OXBLOOD-VIOLET, bruised plum and hematite, with restrained pale copper-pearl highlights on ridges. Broad luminous-by-reflection nacre surfaces stay tactile and organic, never glowing. Old battle scarring, blunt impact fractures and burnished re-fused nacre interrupt the beautiful material; no rot, blisters, slime, open wounds or diseased cavities. Somber ancient-gold and obsidian structural bands are grown into the wrists, forearms, ribs and collarbone, visibly BIOLOGICAL augmentation rather than an armour costume or exposed industrial pistons. Roughly half his skin visible as a loose design balance, especially arms, shoulders, upper chest and portions of flank. No starfield skin, cosmic glitter, rainbow oil slick, neon red/green, bright LEDs or emissive circuit lines.

GENERAL AND PRIEST REGALIA:
Black cloth, polished volcanic glass and restrained worn ancient gold. A short heavy black military half-mantle falls from the armoured shoulder behind the upper back, not a huge flowing king's cape. Two severe narrow ceremonial black stole strips hang down from a low rigid collar, frame the open augmented sternum and end above the knees; worn quiet gold markings and one small broken cult seal imply conviction and rank. Structured black waist-wrap over the hips with a few broad long split panels, knees and lower-leg shapes remain readable. Cloth and armour look deliberately fitted to this being, not a generic ragged wizard robe. Single broad low black-glass pauldron, a few thick old-gold repair joins, minimal trim. No symmetrical massive spiked pauldrons, skull trophies, piles of chains, bright red armour, copies of Khorne symbols, Nazi insignia, known religious garments, eye symbols or ornate crown. Surface hierarchy: large clean shapes first, scars second, tiny ornament last.

ROLE PROP:
One readable original forging implement held firmly in his hand: a squat massive black-glass rectangular STRIKING BLOCK with a single bevelled chisel-like lower face, reinforced by an ancient-gold clamp and a short thick dark handle. Heavy utilitarian tool with ritual care, about the size of his head, not a huge fantasy axe or ambiguous floating magical relic. The head rests solidly on the floor, hand gripping the upright short handle. His long forearm's grown compressive bracer visually echoes the same shape, relating his anatomy to his forging craft. The tool is a concept prop for his camp role, not a new combat ability. No fire, smithy, anvil, background workshop clutter, chainsaw or blood. This is a character reveal, not a combat scene.

ASTRAL PRESENCE:
Restrained thin charcoal-black mist leaks from old scars and regalia edges, curls tightly back around the forearm and feet like controlled pressure. Face and silhouette remain fully readable. No bright effects, fire, halos or giant smoke backdrop.

ART DIRECTION AND LAYOUT:
Polished dark fantasy science-fiction character-design painting with controlled stylization, tactile materials and exceptional silhouette clarity. Full body and tool completely in frame, main figure dominates the left 75% of a landscape sheet, a single matching face expression close-up sits upper right. Warm grey studio background, soft neutral light bright enough to read obsidian-black cloth and subtle violet-red nacre, restrained antique-gold reflected bounce. Same professional presentation standard as a premium character art bible, no rendered miniature base, no toy/chibi proportions, no comic-book poster action, no crushed shadows or busy texture soup. Small understated heading "BUTCHER" and subheading "WEAPONS / GEAR FORGING". No other text, no other characters.
This must feel like an ascended dark astral war-priest officer who forges equipment at camp, distinct from both a rot-swollen friendly patriarch and a regal brain-exposed tactician. Use broad design principles of force, fanatical martial ritual and veteran command, never reproduce any named franchise character.

research.use: Read official Khorne discussion of ritual aggression and regimented masters of warfare; viewed official Bloodbound army image for strong silhouettes and martial-priest identity. Used abstract direction in text, no source image supplied to generator, no named Warhammer character/insignia copied.

inspection: Generated sheet visually inspected: tall muscular narrow-waisted figure, long forceful forearms, sharply rectangular alien head with two eyes and healed scar, oxblood/plum dark marbled skin, single low rectangular pauldron, black/gold ceremonial stoles and half-mantle, block-shaped forging hammer physically held and grounded, thin dark haze. Face and sternum read metallic/armoured more strongly than pearlescent living material; expression reads stern command with anger in the close-up rather than unrestrained frenzy. These remain owner-review points, not reasons to silently reroll.
injuryStatus: Specific Sovereign injury/amputation remains unselected; depicted healed scars are visual proposals.
scope: One Butcher concept only. Leader and approved Glutton v3 preserved. No other Pal work, PixelLab, sprites, animations, production integration, code/build/Unity changes, commits or pushes.
